scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsx deploy/prepare.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts deploy/worker.test.ts
